Tam Velo Club Sunday Recovery Ride

Mill Valley, CA

No-drop

Tam Velo Club Sunday Recovery Ride is a road group ride in Mill Valley, CA. It meets every Sunday, 9:30 am (roll out 9:35 am), weather permitting, starting at Equator Coffees at Proof Lab. Expect about 25–35 miles, moderate, 14–17 mph average, no-drop with regroups.

About the Tam Velo Club Sunday Recovery Ride group ride

Marin's community cycling club runs a shorter Sunday ride from Equator Coffees in Mill Valley. Moderate pace, 25 to 35 miles, with set regroup points. Not a beginner pace, but no one is dropped. A longer, faster ride leaves from the same spot on Saturdays at 8:30 am.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
